The Covid-19 pandemic impacted the music and arts community particularly hard. Musicians who had previously been interviewed for the Fillius Jazz Archive graciously shared their experiences during this virtual shutdown period.
Laurence was interviewed via Zoom on July 21, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m filming for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have guitarist Laurence Juber with me today. Welcome.

I’m not sure irony is the right word but I’d like to point out that four summers ago we had a conversation on film and we were face to face in Glasgow. And now we’re having a second one and we’re both on opposite ends of America.
